name: How do you prevent drywall cracks behind heavy kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: How do you prevent drywall cracks behind heavy kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text:
How do you prevent kitchen drywall seams from cracking under heavy upper cabinets?
Preventing drywall cracking behind upper cabinets requires installing solid 2x6 or 2x8 horizontal wood blocking between the studs before the drywall is hung. Cabinet mounting screws must bite directly into structural wood rather than relying on drywall anchors, which flex and crush the gypsum under the weight of dishes and cookware. Installers also stagger drywall joints away from the high-stress corners of cabinet runs and apply fiberglass mesh or paper tape with high-strength setting-type compound along critical seams to resist shifting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install solid horizontal wood blocking between studs before hanging drywall, and secure cabinet mounting screws directly into framing rather than the drywall panel.
